summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K disclosing a second extension, to September 18, 2026, of the scheduled termination date under its Silver Point credit agreement, with lenders waiving anticipated defaults during the specified period. The company also confirmed it is evaluating strategic alternatives through a special board committee, potentially including financing, recapitalization, restructuring, M&A, and other transactions, asserting significant progress and active third-party, agent, and lender discussions. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or structural terms were disclosed; the filing carries going-concern risk if no transaction or sustainable capital structure emerges. Watch covenant compliance, waiver conditions, and any deal announcement.
